title: Ravel SA – equipment under the cost model
text: On 1 January Y1, Ravel SA buys equipment for its own use for €360 million. It is depreciated straight-line over 30 years with no residual value. Ravel uses the cost model.

On 31 December Y5, the CFO notices that prices for this type of equipment have fallen sharply during the year. Available information: the equipment could be sold for €240 million (net of costs of disposal); it will generate a cash flow of €27 million on 31 December of each remaining year of its useful life; the discount rate is 10%.
Annuity factors at 10%: 30 years 9.42 · 25 years 9.08 · 24 years 8.98 · 20 years 8.51.
